title: Paying teenagers for housework
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás ELLEN érvelsz – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: Teenagers should be paid for doing household chores
candidateIdeas: Helping at home is part of being a member of a family, not a job.
Paying for chores teaches children to help only when there is a reward.
Responsibility and independence are more valuable lessons than money.
Teenagers can learn to manage money through pocket money or a real part-time job instead.
Payment may cause conflicts between siblings and make the family feel like a business.
examinerArguments: Getting paid motivates teenagers to do jobs they would otherwise avoid.
Earning money at home teaches the value of work and how to manage money.
Adults are paid for their work, so why shouldn't teenagers be?
It is safer for teenagers to earn money at home than in a part-time job.
Paying for extra jobs, like washing the car, is fair because it takes time away from studying or friends.
Many families already do this, and it works well for them.

followUpQuestions: But if parents pay for chores, teenagers learn that work has value. Isn't that a good lesson?
Adults are paid for their work. Why should teenagers work for free?
What would you suggest instead to motivate teenagers to help at home?
